versions.content: function ReloadPersistencyManifest [SWS_PER_00577] Upstream: RS_PER_00013 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00128 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < void > ReloadPersistencyManifest () noexcept; Re-reads the Target Configuration. This method can be used to prepare for updates of the Key-Value Storages and File Storages of Persistency after a new Target Configuration was installed by UCM while the Adaptive Application that uses Persistency is running. Storages are only updated after closing them, either when they are opened again or by an explicit call to ara:: per::UpdatePersistency.
